setup_commands:
set -e
cd "$IRIS_WORKDIR"
echo 'syncing deps'
uv sync $([ -f uv.lock ] && echo '--frozen' || echo '') --link-mode symlink --python 3.12 --all-packages --no-dev --extra tpu
if grep -q 'editable = true' pyproject.toml 2>/dev/null; then echo 'rust-dev mode: building native extensions'; for crate in lib/*/pyproject.toml; do grep -q 'build-backend = "maturin"' "$crate" 2>/dev/null && uv pip install -e "$(dirname "$crate")"; done; fi
cd "$IRIS_WORKDIR" 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -d "$IRIS_VENV" ]; then
  echo 'installing iris runtime deps'
  uv pip install --link-mode symlink cloudpickle py-spy memray || echo '[iris setup] runtime deps install failed; continuing'
fi

uv sync $([ -f uv.lock ] && echo '--frozen' || echo '') --link-mode symlink --python 3.12 --all-packages --no-dev --extra tpu
if grep -q 'editable = true' pyproject.toml 2>/dev/null; then echo 'rust-dev mode: building native extensions'; for crate in lib/*/pyproject.toml; do grep -q 'build-backend = "maturin"' "$crate" 2>/dev/null && uv pip install -e "$(dirname "$crate")"; done; fi
cd "$IRIS_WORKDIR" 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -d "$IRIS_VENV" ]; then
  echo 'installing iris runtime deps'
  uv pip install --link-mode symlink cloudpickle py-spy memray || echo '[iris setup] runtime deps install failed; continuing'
fi
